property_summary: After any sequence of calls to addToBalance (and no withdrawal), the caller's userBalance must equal the total ether sent; the mutant makes userBalance always 0 because the function permanently reverts, so the invariant fails for any nonzero deposit.
change_summary: In nonReentrant_ modifier, replace `require(!locked_);` with `require(false);`, making all functions using it (addToBalance and withdrawBalance) permanently revert.
